newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIRU RAND TO APPLY FOR BOURSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: VIRU RAND TO APPLY FOR BOURSE LISTING.

text.p: Estonian fish processor Viru Rand will apply for a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange main list, Baltic Cresco said on Tuesday.

"Viru Rand will be seeking a listing on the main list of the Tallinn stock exchange as soon as it is registered as a limited liability company," Indrek Rahumaa, head of corporate finance at Baltic Cresco, told Reuters.
"We expect to apply to the stock exchange in June," Rahumaa added.
The number of shares to be publically available will be between one million to 1.5 million shares.
"There is no need for a new issue as 30 percent of the shares are held by investment funds and these wil be traded," Rahumaa said.
The shares have a nominal value of 10 kroons and are expected to start trading at 70-75 kroons, he added.
